description: Quote the exact Gold price to make a 3D model from one of the user's own pictures (image_id) or from a description (prompt), with Meshy6, Meshy V7, Meshy V7.1, Rodin v2.5, Trellis 2, Tripo P2, Tripo Parts. Tripo Parts makes a model in separate parts from a picture. Prices depend on the model and its options: Tripo Parts 115 Gold, Tripo P2 115 to 150 Gold; chargen_list_media_models with kind model_3d lists every model's price and options. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_3d_model with the same inputs and quote_token.

hint.description: Tripo Parts only: optional guidance for how to split the parts.

image_id.description: One of the user's own still pictures (from chargen_search_gallery) to make the model from. Give image_id or prompt, not both. Required for Meshy V7, Trellis 2 and Tripo Parts.

options.description: Optional model settings by their exact key, for example {"Texture Quality": "detailed"} for Tripo P2. chargen_list_media_models with kind model_3d lists each model's keys and values; any other key is refused.

prompt.description: A description of the model, for a model that makes models from text. Leave it out when image_id is given.

name: chargen_quote_3d_model
title: Quote 3D model
